segments.orig:
ahurem mazdãm ashavanem ashahe ratûm ýazamaide,
ameshâ speñtâ huxshathrâ hudhånghô
ýazamaide!

asnya ashavana ashahe ratavô ýazamaide, hâvanîm
ashavanem ashahe ratûm ýazamaide, sâvanghaêm
vîsîmca ashavanem ashahe ratûm ýazamaide,
mithrem vouru-gaoyaoitîm hazangra-gaoshem baêvare-cashmanem
aoxtô-nâmanem ýazatem ýazamaide, râma
hvâstrem ýazamaide.
segments.en:
And we worship the Asnya with our sacrifice, and Havani, Savanghi
and Visya, the holy lords of the ritual order, and Mithra of the
wide pastures, of the thousand ears, and myriad eyes, the Yazad
of the spoken name, and we worship Raman Hvastra.
segments.zh: 我們以祭祀崇拜晨禱時辰的持阿沙的聖者、哈瓦尼、薩瓦格以及維斯亞，儀式秩序的聖主；崇拜廣大牧地的密特拉，千耳者、萬眼者，言名的雅匝德；崇拜拉曼‧赫瓦斯特拉。
segments.note: SBE 此處未另譯；本節原文與 Y 6.2 逐字相同，英譯與中譯代入該節。

segments.orig:
rapithwinem ashavanem ashahe ratûm ýazamaide,
frâdat-fshâum zañtumemca ashavanem ashahe ratûm
ýazamaide, ashem vahishtem âtremca ahurahe mazdå
puthrem ýazamaide.
segments.en:
And we worship Rapithwina with our sacrifice, and Fradat-fshu,
and the Zantuma, and Righteousness the Best, and the Fire, Ahura
Mazda's son, holy lords of the ritual order.
segments.zh: 我們以祭祀崇拜拉皮特維納，崇拜弗拉達特-弗舒與贊圖瑪，最善的正義與火，阿胡拉‧馬茲達之子，儀式秩序的聖主。
segments.note: SBE 此處未另譯；本節原文與 Y 6.3 逐字相同，英譯與中譯代入該節。

segments.orig:
uzayeirinem ashavanem ashahe ratûm ýazamaide,
frâdat-vîrem dâh'yumemca ashavanem ashahe ratûm
ýazamaide, berezañtem ahurem xshathrîm xshaêtem
apãm napâtem aurvat-aspem ýazamaide, apemca
mazdadhâtãm ashaonîm ýazamaide.
segments.en:
And we worship Uzayeirina, and Fradat-vira, and Dahvyuma*,
the holy lord of the ritual order, and that kingly Ahura, the
radiant Napat-apam, of the fleet horses, and the water holy, and
Mazda-made.
segments.zh: 我們以祭祀崇拜烏扎埃伊里納，崇拜弗拉達特-維拉與達赫瑜瑪，儀式秩序的聖主；崇拜那位庄嚴的主宰，光輝的納帕特-阿帕姆，駿馬之主，以及聖潔的、阿胡拉‧馬茲達所造的水。
segments.note: SBE 此處未另譯；本節原文與 Y 6.4 逐字相同，英譯與中譯代入該節。

segments.orig:
aiwisrûthrimem aibigâim ashavanem ashahe ratûm
ýazamaide, frâdat-vîspãm-hujyâitîm
zarathushtrôtememca ashavanem ashahe ratûm ýazamaide,
ashâunãm vanguhîsh sûrå speñtå
fravashayô ýazamaide, khnåsca vîrô-vãthwå
ýazamaide, ýâiryãmca hushitîm
ýazamaide, amemca hutashtem huraodhem ýazamaide,
verethrakhnemca ahuradhâtem ýazamaide, vanaiñtîmca
uparatâtem ýazamaide.
segments.en:
And we worship Aiwisruthrima and Aibigaya in our sacrifice,
the holy lord of the ritual order, and Fradat-vispam-hujyaiti
and the Zarathushtrotema, the holy lord of the ritual order, and
the good, heroic, bountiful Fravashis of the saints, and the women
who bring forth many sons, and the Prosperous home-life which
endures without reverse throughout the year, and Force which is
well-shaped and stately, and the Blow which brings the victory,
which is Ahura-given, and the Victorious Ascendency (which it
secures).
segments.zh:
我們在祭祀中敬拜艾維斯魯特裡瑪與艾比蓋亞，
儀式秩序的聖主，以及弗拉達特─維斯帕姆─胡傑亞提，
以及查拉圖斯特羅特瑪，儀式秩序的聖主，以及
善良的、英勇的、豐盛的聖者弗拉瓦希，以及那些女性
生育眾多子嗣者，以及繁榮的家庭生活，
全年未有逆轉而永存不衰，以及力量，
形態優美而莊嚴，以及帶來勝利的打擊，
那是阿胡拉所賜的，以及得勝的至高權力（它
所保證的）。
segments.note: SBE 此處未另譯；本節原文與 Y 6.5 逐字相同，英譯與中譯代入該節。

segments.orig:
ushahinem ashavanem ashahe ratûm ýazamaide, berejîm
nmânîmca ashavanem ashahe ratûm ýazamaide,
sraoshem ashîm huraodhem verethrâjanem frâdat-
gaêthem ashavanem ashahe ratûm ýazamaide, rashnûm
razishtem ýazamaide, arshtâtemca frâdat-gaêthãm
varedat-gaêthãm ýazamaide!
segments.en:
And we worship Ushahina with our sacrifice, and Berejya, and
Nmanya, and Sraosha (Obedience) the blessed and the stately who
smites with victory, and makes the settlements advance, and Rashnu,
the most just, and Arshtat who makes the settlements advance and
causes them to increase, the holy lords of the ritual order.
segments.zh: 我們以祭祀崇拜烏莎希納，崇拜貝雷基亞與尼曼亞，被祝福、莊嚴的斯魯沙（服從），以勝利打擊者，促進定居地前進者；崇拜最公正的拉什努；崇拜阿爾什塔特，促進定居地前進與繁榮增長者，儀式秩序的聖主。
segments.note: SBE 此處未另譯；本節原文與 Y 6.6 逐字相同，英譯與中譯代入該節。

segments.orig:
mâhya ashavana ashahe ratavô ýazamaide,
añtaremånghem ashavanem ashahe ratûm ýazamaide,
perenô-månghem vîshaptathem ashavanem ashahe
ratûm ýazamaide!
segments.en:
And we worship the Mahya in our sacrifice, the new moon and
the waning moon (the moon within) and the full moon which scatters
night, the holy lord of the ritual order.
segments.zh: 我們以祭祀崇拜月份，新月與殘月（月內）與破夜的滿月，儀式秩序的聖主。
segments.note: SBE 此處未另譯；本節原文與 Y 6.7 逐字相同，英譯與中譯代入該節。

segments.orig:
ýâirya ashavana ashahe ratavô ýazamaide,
maidhyôizaremaêm ashavanem ashahe ratûm ýazamaide,
maidhyôishemem ashavanem ashahe ratûm ýazamaide,
paitishhahîm ashavanem ashahe ratûm ýazamaide,
ayâthrimem fraourvaêshtrimem varshniharshtem ashavanem
ashahe ratûm ýazamaide, maidhyâirîm ashavanem
ashahe ratûm ýazamaide, hamaspathmaêdaêm
ashavanem ashahe ratûm ýazamaide, saredha ashavana
ashahe ratavô ýazamaide.
segments.en:
And we worship the Yearly festivals in our sacrifice, Maidhya-zaremaya, 
Maidhyo-shema, Paitishhahya, and Ayathrima, the furtherer (or
breeder), the spender of virile strength, and Maidhyairya, the
holy lord of the ritual order, and Hamaspathmaedhaya, and the
Seasons (in which they are).
segments.zh: 我們以祭祀崇拜節慶日，邁德亞-扎雷瑪亞、邁德霍-舍瑪、派提什哈海亞與阿亞特里瑪，促進者（或孳生者），花費壯力者，邁德亞伊里亞，儀式秩序的聖主，以及哈馬斯帕特赫邁德哈亞，以及其中的四時。
segments.note: SBE 此處未另譯；本節原文與 Y 6.8 逐字相同，英譯與中譯代入該節。

segments.orig:
vîspe ashahe ratavô ýazamaide ýôi
heñti ashahe ratavô thrayasca thrisãsca nazdishta
pairishhâvanayô ýôi heñti ashahe
ýat vahishtahe mazdô-frasâsta zarathushtrô-fraoxta!
segments.en:
And we worship with our sacrifice all the lords of the ritual
order, who are the thirty and three who approach the nearest around
about us at Havani, who are the lords of Righteousness the Best,
and whose observances were inculcated by Ahura Mazda, and uttered
forth by Zarathushtra.
segments.zh: 我們以祭祀崇拜儀式秩序的全部聖主，即三十三位在晨禱時辰環繞我們四周最親近的聖主，他們是最善的正義之主，其遵行之法由阿胡拉‧馬茲達訓導、由查拉圖斯特拉宣示。
segments.note: SBE 此處未另譯；本節原文與 Y 6.9 逐字相同，英譯與中譯代入該節。

segments.orig:
ahura mithra berezañta aithyajangha ashavana ýazamaide,
strêushca månghemca hvareca urvarâhu paiti baresmanyâhu
mithrem vîspanãm dah'yunãm dainghupaitîm
ýazamaide, (...rôz...) ahurem mazdãm raêvañtem
hvarenanguhañtem ýazamaide, ( ... mâh ...
) ashâunãm vanguhîsh sûrå speñtå
fravashayô ýazamaide!
segments.en:
And we worship Ahura and Mithra with our sacrifice, the lofty,
and imperishable, and holy two, and the stars, moon, and sun,
among the plants of the Baresman, and Mithra, the province-lord
of all the provinces, even Ahura Mazda, the radiant, the glorious,
and the good, valiant, and bountiful Fravashis of the saints.
segments.zh: 我們以犧牲祭祀阿胡拉和密特拉，崇高的、不朽的、持阿沙的聖者啊！以及眾星、月亮和太陽，在巴爾斯曼的植物中。我們祭祀密特拉，一切地域的地域主。我們以犧牲祭祀阿胡拉‧馬茲達，光耀的、榮耀的，以及良善的、勇武的、恩慈的聖人不朽聖者。
segments.note: SBE 此處未另譯；本節原文與 Y 6.10 逐字相同，英譯與中譯代入該節。

segments.orig:
thwãm âtrem ahurahe mazdå puthrem ýazamaide,
âtrem berezisavanghem ýazamaide, âtrem vohu-fryânem
ýazamaide, âtrem urvâzishtem ýazamaide,
âtrem vâzishtem ýazamaide, âtrem spênishtem
ýazamaide, xshathrem nafedhrem nairyô-sanghem ýazatem
ýazamaide, âtrem vîspanãm nmânanãm
nmânô-paitîm mazdadhâtem ahurahe mazdå
puthrem ashavanem ashahe ratûm ýazamaide mat vîspaêibyô
âterebyô.
segments.en:
We worship thee, the Fire, O Ahura Mazda's son! We worship
the fire Berezi-savangha (of the lofty use), and the fire Vohu-fryana
(the good and friendly), and the fire Urvazishta (the most beneficial
and most helpful), and the fire Vazishta (the most supporting),
and the fire Spenishta (the most bountiful), and Nairya-sangha
the Yazad of the royal lineage, and that fire which is the house-lord
of all houses and Mazda-made, even the son of Ahura Mazda, the
holy lord of the ritual order, with all the fires.
segments.zh:
我們敬拜你，火啊，阿胡拉‧馬茲達之子！我們敬拜
火焰貝雷茲‧薩瓦格哈（至高之用），以及火焰沃胡‧弗里亞納
（善良而友善），以及火焰烏爾瓦茲什塔（最有益且最有幫助
者），以及火焰瓦茲什塔（最有支持者），
以及火焰斯佩尼什塔（最豐盛者），以及奈里亞‧桑格哈
王權之雅茲德，以及那作為家主的火焰
一切家宅的，以及阿胡拉‧馬茲達所造的，甚至阿胡拉‧馬茲達之子的，
持阿沙的聖者，帶著一切的火。

segments.orig:
âpô vanguhîsh vahishtå mazdadhâtå
ashaonîsh ýazamaide, vîspå âpô
mazdadhâtå ashaonîsh ýazamaide, vîspå
urvarå mazdadhâtå ashaonîsh ýazamaide!
segments.en:
And we worship the good and best waters Mazda-made, holy,
all the waters Mazda-made and holy, and all the plants which Mazda
made, and which are holy.
segments.zh: 我們禮拜善良最善的馬茲達所造的水，持阿沙的聖者啊，禮拜一切馬茲達所造持阿沙的聖者的水，禮拜馬茲達所造持阿沙的聖者的一切植物。

segments.orig:
mãthrem speñtem ashhvarenanghem ýazamaide,
dâtem vîdôyûm ýazamaide, dâtem
zarathushtri ýazamaide, darekhãm upayanãm
ýazamaide, daênãm vanguhîm mâzdayasnîm
ýazamaide.
segments.en:
And we worship the Mathra-spenta (the bounteous word-of-reason),
the Zarathushtrian law against the Daevas, and its long descent.
segments.zh: 我們禮拜至聖的真言，查拉圖斯特拉的反達埃瓦之法，及其久遠的傳承。

segments.orig:
gairîm ushidarenem mazdadhâtem ashahvâthrem
ýazatem ýazamaide, vîspå garayô
ashahvâthrå pouru-hvâthrå mazdadhâta
ashavana ashahe ratavô ýazamaide, ukhrem kavaêm
hvarenô mazdadhâtem ýazamaide, ukhrem ahvaretem
hvarenô mazdadhâtem ýazamaide, ashîm
vanguhîm ýazamaide, xshôithnîm berezaitîm
amavaitîm huraodhãm hvâparãm, hvarenô
mazdadhâtem ýazamaide, savô mazdadhâtem
ýazamaide.
segments.en:
And we worship Mount Ushi-darena which is Mazda-made and shining
with its holiness, and all the mountains shining with holiness,
and of abundant glory, and which Mazda made ---.
segments.zh: 我們禮拜烏希‧達雷納山，馬茲達所造，以持阿沙的聖者照耀，禮拜一切以持阿沙的聖者照耀、富於榮光、由馬茲達所造的山嶺。

segments.orig:
dahmãm vanguhîm âfritîm ýazamaide,
dahmemca narem ashavanem ýazamaide, ukhrem taxmem dâmôish
upamanem ýazatem ýazamaide!
segments.zh: 我們禮拜善良虔誠的祝禱之言，禮拜此等水與（此等土地），禮拜一切偉大的族長、儀式秩序的諸主。

segments.orig:
imå apasca zemasca urvaråsca ýazamaide,
imå asåsca shôithråsca gaoyaoitîshca
maêthanyåsca avô-hvarenåsca ýazamaide,
imemca shôithrahe paitîm ýazamaide ýim
ahurem mazdãm.
segments.en:
And we worship these waters, lands, and plants, these places,
districts, pastures, and abodes with their springs of water, and
we worship this lord of the district with our sacrifice, who is
Ahura Mazda (Himself).
segments.zh: 我們祭祀這些水、土地和植物，這些地方、地區、牧場和住所及其水泉。我們以犧牲祭祀此地區之主，他即阿胡拉‧馬茲達。
segments.note: SBE 此處未另譯；本節原文與 Y 6.15 逐字相同，英譯與中譯代入該節。

segments.orig:
ratavô vîspe mazishta ýazamaide ayara asnya
mâhya ýâirya saredha!

ashâunãm vanguhîsh sûrå speñtå
fravashayô staomi zbayemi ufyemi, ýazamaide nmânyå
vîsyå zañtumå dâh'yumå zarathushtrôtemå.
segments.en:
And I praise, invoke, and glorify the good, heroic, bountiful
Fravashis of the saints, those of the house, the Vis, the Zantuma,
the Dahvyuma, and the Zarathushtrotema, and all the holy Yazads!
<H2 id=y18
segments.zh: 我讚頌、祈禱、禮拜善良英勇豐裕的聖人弗拉瓦希，家族的弗拉瓦希、族人的弗拉瓦希、贊圖瑪的弗拉瓦希、達赫尤瑪的弗拉瓦希、查拉圖斯特拉特瑪的弗拉瓦希，及一切持阿沙的聖者的雅贊德。

segments.orig:
vîspe ashavanô ýazata ýazamaide,
vîspe ashahe ratavô ýazamaide, hâvanîm
paiti ratûm sâvanghaêm vîsîmca paiti
ratûm ratavô vîspe mazishta paiti ratûm.
ýenghê hâtãm âat ýesnê
paitî ... !!
